card.name: Agriculture and land-grant institution names
card.fires_on: Words in agricultural extension or university text that lead into a place or institution name, such as 'for', 'from', or a state name. Also partway through names like Nebraska and Tennessee in farm news.

modes.label: Link word before institution
modes.description: A small word after a job title or expert that leads into a department, university or region.
modes.example: a poultry extension specialist<< for>> the Department of Animal Science

modes.label: Inside place and publication names
modes.description: Parts of state names, farm magazine titles or web addresses of extension sites.

card.writes: It nudges output toward land-related words such as 'land' and 'Land', and toward 'Mid'.
card.plain: It lights up in farming and university extension news, on words that lead into a state or institution name.
